answer: The ledge is not the document; it is the decade behind the document. A County archivist certification with archives service attestation proves it: a certification the service renews after cataloguing audits. The verifier reads the file's age, not its print quality. The tide is the age — ten years of entries no printer can backdate. The zenith is the farm's dilemma: it can forge the paper in a day, but the decade still has to be lived, one slow year at a time.
